observed.metadataSource: GitHub connector GET public REST release collections, per-release asset collections and latest endpoint

latest.title: Community Build of .NET SDK 10.0.403 - Linux archives r3 (built by .NET Dev)

protectedFiles.byteComparison: Pinned current HEAD Git blobs versus baseline Git blobs are compared byte-for-byte. Current workingtree clean-filter Git object IDs must also equal baseline blob IDs; initial raw workingtree SHA256 pins are compared separately without normalization.

limits: Asset payloads were not re-downloaded. Actual REST asset IDs, sizes, SHA256 digest metadata, content types and canonical URLs were compared.
The bounded REST collection is not an atomic server snapshot; every embedded release asset inventory was independently reconciled with its separate complete assets endpoint response.

The initial Windows checkout contains pre-existing CRLF transformations for some files. Those raw bytes are not falsely described as equal to LF Git blobs; committed bytes, clean-filter tracked content and all nine captured initial raw SHA256 pins are recorded separately.
This audit does not qualify musl source builds, runtime behavior, signatures or public installation.
This post-publication checkpoint uses fresh connected REST snapshots and excludes only new explicit musl namespace tags. Old releases/assets and latest remain protected.

oldGlibcOci.aliasDiscoveryScope: All baseline docs/releases JSON and Markdown containing this GHCR repository, plus every SHA-bound GPG-verified OCI index and per-platform descriptor in published status receipts.
oldGlibcOci.deferredAliases: Baseline docs/oci-delivery.md explicitly defer mutable latest, 10.0 and unsuffixed SDK aliases; no published such alias references were discovered or guessed.
criteria: Each signed receipt manifest SHA and OpenPGP signer match the baseline committed status.
Each actual canonical-tag raw manifest SHA256 equals both Docker-Content-Digest response header and the signed index digest.
The two native child descriptors and exact raw child/config SHA256 metadata match signed per-CPU descriptors; no image filesystem layers are downloaded.
Any explicit published tag alias discovered in baseline docs/status must retain its before digest.

transport.notes: Only bounded JSON registry manifests/configs and small signed release metadata were fetched. No Docker image pull/run/build or authenticated registry login was used.
